description: Use when ARC demos show special-color pixels casting vertical trails. Infer and apply downward shadow fills.

# ARC downward shadow rule

For ARC-style grid tasks where a demo has a background color, a source/obstacle color, and a third output color, check for vertical projections: each source cell casts a trail straight down its column, recoloring background cells to the trail color until the next source/obstacle or the bottom edge. Preserve source cells and unrelated/background cells outside trails.

## Evidence / application
- In the observed task, 6 pixels cast trails of 3 downward through background 1; later 6 cells block the trail.
- On a narrow test, 8 source cells in one column produced 3s below the consecutive source run, stopping at the next 8. The other cells were preserved.

## Procedure
1. Compare each source-color location to output in same-column cells below it.
2. Verify trails stop at source-color blockers and do not extend upward or sideways.
3. Apply that rule to the test, preserving all original non-background cells and changing only covered background cells to the trail color.
4. Check grid dimensions and every blocker before submitting.
